# Naail Food & Beverages

> Pakistan-based manufacturer of juices, carbonated drinks, bottled water and packaged foods, based in Sheikhupura, Punjab.

## Pages
- [Home](https://naailbeverages.com/index.md)
- [Talk to us about <span>distribution.</span>](https://naailbeverages.com/contact/index.md): Reach the Naail Food & Beverages head office in Sheikhupura for distributor enquiries, bulk orders or plant visits.
- [WE ARE NAAIL FOOD & BEVERAGES. BOTTLING PUNJAB'S HARVEST SINCE 2011.](https://naailbeverages.com/about/index.md): A Pakistan-based food and beverage manufacturer in Sheikhupura, Punjab, producing juices, carbonated drinks, drinking water and packaged snacks for distributors across all four provinces.

## Naail News
- [Naail News](https://naailbeverages.com/blog/index.md): Plant updates, sourcing news and certification announcements from Naail Food & Beverages, Sheikhupura.

- [Third water line commissioned at Sheikhupura](https://naailbeverages.com/blog/new-water-line-commissioned/index.md): A third bottling line lifts drinking-water capacity to 60,000 bottles a day ahead of the summer peak.
- [Mango intake for 2026 closes 12% above last season](https://naailbeverages.com/blog/mango-season-2026/index.md): Contracted pulp from Multan and Rahim Yar Khan comes in ahead of plan despite a late start.
- [ISO 22000 recertified through 2028](https://naailbeverages.com/blog/iso-22000-recertification/index.md): The Sheikhupura plant clears its three-year food safety recertification audit with no major findings.

## We bottle <span>juice, water and fizz</span> for distributors across <span>Pakistan</span>
- [We bottle <span>juice, water and fizz</span> for distributors across <span>Pakistan</span>](https://naailbeverages.com/products/index.md): Juices, carbonated drinks, drinking water and packaged snacks from Naail Food & Beverages, Sheikhupura.

- [NAAIL MANGO NECTAR](https://naailbeverages.com/products/naail-mango-nectar/index.md): The drink the company was built on. Forty percent mango pulp from Multan and Rahim Yar Khan, with no artificial colour …
- [NAAIL CITRUS PUNCH](https://naailbeverages.com/products/naail-citrus-punch/index.md): A blend of orange and kinnow concentrate from the Sargodha belt, lighter and sharper than our mango line.

- [NAAIL FIZZ](https://naailbeverages.com/products/naail-fizz/index.md): Three carbonated flavours produced on our 2016 line: Naail Cola, Naail Lemon-Lime and Naail Ginger.

- [NAAIL DRINKING WATER](https://naailbeverages.com/products/naail-drinking-water/index.md): Drawn from two on-site bores, treated by reverse osmosis and UV, and bottled on a dedicated line that handles nothing …
- [NAAIL SNACKS](https://naailbeverages.com/products/naail-snacks/index.md): Our dry snack division opened in 2018 in a separate hall on the Sheikhupura site, with its own intake, roasting and …
